title: Single hieratic sign, Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 3056 (AKU HT 554)

object.name: Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 3056

source.attribution: Georg Möller, Hieratische Paläographie, retro-digitised by AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 554

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 554; AKU grapheme D0270 (AKU GR 137). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: D21 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 714, 91, 91B. Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1936a, 8. Occurrence: line 9; find place Ägypten (unlokalisiert); writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; sign size 2.7 x 8.1 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Dritte Zwischenzeit, 22.–23. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
